## Pull request overview

Adds a VS Code–style collapsible AI Chat panel to Studio (right-edge dock), backed by Vercel AI SDK streaming and persisted UI state/history.

**Changes:**
- Introduces `AiChatPanel` UI with streaming chat (Vercel AI SDK) and local history persistence.
- Adds `useAiChatPanel` hook for open/close state, localStorage persistence, and a global keyboard shortcut.
- Adds Studio deps (`ai`, `@ai-sdk/react`) plus initial Vitest coverage and changelog entry.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Locks new AI SDK dependencies and transitives. |
| apps/studio/package.json | Adds `ai` and `@ai-sdk/react` runtime deps for the chat panel. |
| apps/studio/src/components/AiChatPanel.tsx | New floating/collapsible panel UI + streaming chat integration. |
| apps/studio/src/hooks/use-ai-chat-panel.ts | New hook for panel state, keyboard shortcut, and message persistence helpers. |
| apps/studio/src/App.tsx | Mounts `<AiChatPanel />` globally within the Studio layout. |
| apps/studio/test/ai-chat-panel.test.tsx | Adds tests for localStorage helpers and panel-related constants/behavior. |
| apps/studio/CHANGELOG.md | Documents the new AI Chat panel feature under Unreleased. |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

`loadMessages()` returns any JSON array without validating elements. If localStorage contains `[null]` or non-object entries, `AiChatPanel` will crash when calling `getMessageText(msg)` / reading `msg.role`. Consider filtering to only non-null objects and minimally validating `{ id, role, parts }` (or using a small schema) before returning.

The `ScrollArea` component uses Radix’s internal `Viewport` as the scroll container, but this panel introduces a nested `div` with `overflow-y-auto` and performs `scrollTop` updates on that inner div. This can break Radix scrollbars and auto-scroll behavior. Prefer scrolling the Radix viewport (or remove the nested overflow container) and attach `scrollRef` to the actual scroll element.
The collapsed toggle `<button>` has no accessible name (only an icon). Add an `aria-label` (e.g., "Open AI chat") or a visually-hidden text span so screen readers can identify the control.

This test name/intent says it toggles via a dispatched `Ctrl+Shift+I` keyboard event, but it only sets localStorage values directly and never exercises the hook’s `keydown` listener. Either dispatch a real `KeyboardEvent` against `window` with the hook/component mounted, or rename the test to reflect what it actually verifies.
